analysis.summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is recommended to investigate the cause of the failure and optimize the page to improve its load time.
insights: The pricing page and blog page have the best load times, at 302.3ms and 224.8ms, respectively. Analyzing these pages can provide insights into best practices for optimizing the other pages.

The Time To First Byte (TTFB) is relatively low for all pages, indicating that the server response time is good. This is a positive sign, as it means that the server is not a bottleneck in page load times.

The First Contentful Paint (FCP) is generally consistent across pages, ranging from 14.8ms to 179.6ms. This metric shows when the first piece of content is rendered on the page, and its consistency indicates that the pages are loading their initial content quickly.
